title: Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes
subtitle: Another mercenary enters Fódlan
summary: Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes is Omega Force's action role-playing game, released for Nintendo Switch on 24 June 2022.
body: Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes is Omega Force's action role-playing game, released for Nintendo Switch on 24 June 2022. It returns to Fódlan, the setting of Fire Emblem: Three Houses, through the mercenary Shez. Choosing an alliance opens one of three campaigns in an alternative version of that world's conflict. Large battles replace the earlier game's turn-based encounters, while familiar characters, classes and relationships connect the fighting to the political divisions and personal loyalties surrounding the three nations.

The player fights directly through groups of soldiers, captures strongholds and defeats commanders, switching between selected allies as objectives change. Orders let other units attack or defend elsewhere on the map. A strong fighter is therefore only part of the plan: someone must also reach the threatened position before its defenders fall. Weapon advantages and classes influence those assignments. Conquering smaller territories provides resources and strategic options for a region's main battle, allowing preparation to change how the larger encounter begins.

Between missions, the camp gives the army time to train, improve equipment and strengthen relationships through conversations and shared activities. Support between characters has practical value when they assist one another in combat. The player can spend resources to develop different classes and abilities before choosing the next mission. Three Hopes carries the ensemble of Three Houses into a more immediate form of action, keeping the wider campaign present through the people sent into battle and the preparations made when they return.
